title: HTTPS endpoint whose certificate chain and hostname both verified
rationale: C11 is a prevalence measure, not a violation detector: a refused handshake surfaces as a transport error and R4 classifies that as ERROR rather than as non-conformance. Its PASS still carries information, because it is the precondition every other check rests on. This fixture also pins that an open endpoint is NOT_APPLICABLE for the OAuth checks rather than failing them.

spec.quote: All authorization server endpoints MUST be served over HTTPS.
Authorization is OPTIONAL for MCP implementations.

response.comment: httpx verifies chain and hostname, so a completed handshake is the evidence; no request is issued by this fixture at all
